title: canair capture file
description: Machine schema for captures/*.json (format-agnostic — validates the parsed structure). Authoritative; the human-readable companion is docs/concepts/captures-and-states.md. Cross-checks that can't be expressed here (rx address must resolve via ecus/, filename must match session date) live in canlib/commands/validate/captures.py.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, optionally with a -<suffix> for a second same-day session.

version.description: The canair version that recorded this session. A plain release for an installed copy (e.g. '1.4.2'); recorded from a git checkout it carries that checkout's branch and short commit as a local version segment (e.g. '1.15.0+main.343b244', '+…dirty' when tracked files were modified), so the exact code that produced the payloads is identifiable. Provenance for debugging capture issues traced to a specific tool build. Absent on sessions recorded before version stamping was added.

vehicle_states.description: Power states the car was in during this session (vocabulary from vehicle_states.yaml). Array of tokens, e.g. [ready, parked].

keep_mode.description: How the monitor deduplicated payloads: 'changes' (run-length) stores a payload only when it differs from the immediately preceding one per PID, so value-transitions and dwell durations are preserved; 'unique' (legacy global dedup) stores a payload only when it differs from any seen before, so return-to-previous transitions and durations are absent. Absent/other = every polled payload kept.

transport.description: How the payloads were acquired: the transport label ('slcan-tcp' / 'wican-ws') for a device-recorded session, or 'import' for a device-free import. Provenance for judging data trustworthiness.

capture.description: Exactly one payload field (payload, response, or scan_results) must be present.

rx.description: ECU CAN response address (RX = request TX + 8), e.g. 0x7EC; or the 'broadcast' sentinel for multi-ECU scans.

pid.description: PID/DID string, e.g. 2101, 22BC03. Bare-integer values are tolerated.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock UDS round-trip in ms (transport + ECU, not pure ECU time). Recorded only for single per-DID reads on the live query path; absent for batched multi-DID reads, monitor --save, scans, and imports. Comparable only within the same session 'transport'.

responding_entry.description: A responder is keyed by 'did' (DID/service scans) or 'rx' (broadcast/discover scans).

quality.description: Transport data-quality footprint recorded at capture time (from the client's exchange tally). Always carries 'exchanges'; error categories appear only when non-zero. NRCs are legitimate ECU answers and are not counted here.

exchanges.description: Total UDS exchanges during the session.

stale.description: SID/echo/NRC-echo mismatches (a stale frame leaking from a prior request).
